[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
When App Mesh is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray write policy to the node role, but aws_autoscaling_group.ng does not depend on that attachment. Instances can launch before the policy is attached.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
When App Mesh/X-Ray is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray permissions to the node role, but aws_autoscaling_group.ng can launch instances before that attachment completes. It should be ordered with the other node role policy attachments.

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run1]
When App Mesh is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray write policy to the managed node group's role, but aws_eks_node_group.ng does not depend on that attachment. Nodes can be created before the policy is attached.

----------------------------------------

[final-deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-effort-high-run3]
When App Mesh/X-Ray is enabled, aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.xray-write attaches the X-Ray permissions to the node role, but aws_eks_node_group.ng can create nodes before that attachment completes. It should be ordered with the other node role policy attachments.
